title: Verifier Receipt
description: Extension fields for verification-wave-<N>-<timestamp>.json. Extends receipt.base.schema.json.

verification_mode.description: Mode declared in the wave plan entry

verdict.description: PASS = advance. FAIL = enter REVISE loop. BLOCKED = pause, escalate to human.

spec_compliance.description: Result of spec compliance check (runs first, before mode-specific check)

revise_cycles_used.description: Number of REVISE cycles consumed for this wave. Resets at each new wave.

immediate_blocked.description: True when BLOCKED without entering REVISE loop (hardware unavailable, irreversible action, deadlocked dependency)

attestation_required.description: True when human Attestation is required before execution can proceed

attestation_received.description: True when human Attestation has been explicitly confirmed

fix_recommendation.description: Required when verdict is FAIL. Specific: which criterion, what correct output, where to change.

spec_compliance_failures.description: Spec compliance failures found. Empty when spec_compliance = PASS.

mode_check_result.description: Result of the mode-specific check (independent of spec compliance)
